routes.name: Visa on arrival
routes.summary: Citizens of the countries on Bahrain's official on-arrival list can get a visa at the airport or border. Conditions apply per country, and entry is never guaranteed. Use the eVisa eligibility check to see your terms.

other: Official list is long and mixed (many European, American and Asian countries, among others). Stay length and fee depend on nationality and were not shown on the list page.
Entry is at the discretion of the immigration officer.

sources.label: Bahrain eVisa, list of on-arrival visa countries

routes.name: Electronic visit visa (eVisa)
routes.summary: Apply online on the official Bahrain eVisa site if your nationality is on the online list. The visa is emailed to you and you print it. Nothing is stamped in your passport until you arrive. The fee is not refunded if you are refused.

other: Nationality must be on the official online visa list. Conditions, validity and period of stay show on the eligibility check, and were not read here.

steps: Check eligibility on the eVisa site.
Fill in the application and upload documents.
Pay by card through the site.
Print the visa and use the same passport to enter.
routes.processing: Not stated on the pages we read.

sources.label: Bahrain eVisa, list of online visa countries

routes.name: Visit visa through a guarantor
routes.summary: If your nationality is not on the eVisa or on-arrival lists, a Bahraini company, organization or citizen can sponsor your visit visa. Your airline, hotel or a Bahrain travel agent can also help.

other: Needs a local guarantor: a Bahrain company, organization or citizen.

routes.name: Airport transit (under 8 hours)
routes.summary: No visa if you stay in the airport for up to 8 hours and don't leave it. Past 8 hours, a visa can be granted.

routes.name: Visit visa extension
routes.summary: You can extend a visit visa once you are in Bahrain. Go to the NPRA main office in Manama or the MOI service center in Muharraq and pay the extension fee. The national portal also lists an online extension service.

other: Fee and maximum extension not stated on the pages we read.

routes.name: Golden Residency Visa
routes.summary: Bahrain offers a Golden Residency Visa, with a separate request for relatives. You apply through the national portal. The NPRA page with the criteria and amounts was blocked, so thresholds and length are not confirmed here.

other: Criteria, amounts and validity not confirmed. Check the NPRA golden residency page before relying on this.

sources.label: Bahrain national portal, Golden Residency services
